data.title: Invitation to appointment at immigration office
data.summary: The Berlin immigration office (Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster) invites Nora Musterova to an in-person appointment on 15 October 2026 at 10:45 about her residence permit extension application of 1 September 2026.
data.explanation: The office needs to see you in person to process your extension application. Go to House B, waiting area 2, on 15 October 2026 at 10:45. Bring your passport, current employer certificate, rental contract and a biometric photo. Your provisional certificate (Fiktionsbescheinigung) stays valid until the decision. If you can't attend, contact the office in advance using the contact details on the letter.
